info.name: Automile ClientApi ResourceOwnerTripV2 API
ResourceOwnerTripV2
Get all trips that the user has access to

params.name: lastNumberOfDays
params.description: Optional enter last number of days to get trips for. Only supports up to 60 days back. If not speficied or more then 60 days are entered it searches 30 days back.

params.name: vehicleId
params.description: Optional vehicle id to get trips for

params.name: synchronized
params.description: Optional include synchronized trips (defaults to true)

params.name: fromUtc
params.description: Retrieve trips from this date. (Can't be used if lastNumberOfDays is specified)

params.name: toUtc
params.description: Retrieve trips to this date. (Can't be used if lastNumberOfDays is specified)

items.docs: Only returns trips that the user have access to. If more then 60 days are requested it defaults to 30 days.
